name: Compass
summary: Shopify app that joins Meta ad spend with real store sales to show blended ROAS per campaign, answers plain-English questions about your ads and products (Ask Compass) and sends a weekly report with suggested actions. One plan with every feature.
best_for: Shopify merchants who spend on Meta ads and want one simple view of which campaigns turn into real store sales, with plain-English answers instead of Ads Manager reports
skip_if: your ad budget runs mostly through Google, TikTok or other channels, or you are not comfortable giving a new app broad access to store and customer data
honest_knock: It covers Meta ads only. The app asks for broad store access, including edit access to customers, products and orders, for what is an analytics tool. The privacy policy names OpenAI among the services that receive your inputs, and the terms allow usage limits at the developer's discretion. Compass launched in May 2026 and had 3 reviews on the listing when we read it, and no refund policy is published.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Compass · per month, one plan with every feature, billed in USD every 30 days through the Shopify App Store
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-27 on the Compass listing in the Shopify App Store; the terms and privacy policy were read on 2026-10-15) Compass has a single plan with every feature included: $49 a month, or $490 a year, which the listing says saves 17%. There is a 14-day free trial and no free plan. The listing says all charges are billed in USD, every 30 days, through Shopify. Compass's site adds that there are no setup fees and that you can cancel at any time. We found no published refund policy, and no stated limit on Ask Compass questions, stores or ad accounts; the terms do say the AI assistant is for reasonable business use and that usage limits may be imposed.

compare_with.name: Helm
compare_with.why: Helm is in our dossiers as a broader Shopify business-intelligence app: on 4 October 2026 its single Operator plan was $129 a month or $1,299 a year. Compass is narrower and cheaper at $49 a month: it is built around Meta ad spend against store sales, with an AI assistant for questions
